notes: Carl descends the entrance staircase into Floor 1. The system designates him Crawler #4,122 'Carl', race Human, Level 1 (he may re-pick race/class on Floor 3). A wall of entry achievements grants loot boxes he can't yet open. Both his pink Crocs fly off as he flees a goblin Murder Dozer; he kills a club-wielding goblin with his bare hands, reads the real Tutorial Guild sign, and talks his way inside past the guildmaster Mordecai.

set.location: World Dungeon — Floor 1 (entrance tunnels, near the Tutorial Guild)

add.name: Crazy Cat Lady
add.description: You have entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. Ahh, isn’t that sweet?
add.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Pet Box!

add.name: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
add.description: You are the first crawler to have entered to the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat. You must really love that thing. Too bad you’re both probably going to die a horrible death at any moment. Or maybe not. Look at the prize you just received!
add.reward: You’ve received a Legendary Pet Box!

add.name: Early Adopter
add.description: You are one of the first 5,000 Crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon. Sucker.
add.reward: You’ve received a Silver Adventurer Box!

add.name: Empty pockets
add.description: You didn’t bring any supplies. None. You know you still gotta eat, right?
add.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Adventurer Box!

add.name: Why aren’t you wearing pants?
add.description: You entered the dungeon wearing no pants. Dude. Seriously?
add.reward: You’ve received a Gold Apparel Box!

add.name: Unarmed combat
add.description: So. You just gonna waltz right into something called a “World Dungeon” and you’re not even going to bring a weapon? You’re either braver than you look, or you’re just an idiot. Good luck with that, Van Damme.
add.reward: You’ve received a Bronze Weapon Box!

add.name: Loner
add.description: You entered the dungeon without any human companions. Didn’t anyone teach you there is safety in numbers?
add.reward: None! Haha. You are so dead.

add.name: Fall into an obvious trap
add.reward: Well, if there’s a heaven, and if you haven’t been too much of an asshole, maybe they’ll let you in. Because you about to meet your maker.
add.note: No commentary line for this one: the box went straight from the name to the reward. Earned by walking down the 'Da Tutorial Guild' alley into the goblin Murder Dozer ambush.

add.name: You’ve discovered and read an official dungeon sign
add.reward: All official dungeon signage will now be highlighted and easier to spot. Nearby guilds will appear on your minimap.
add.note: Read the genuine 'Tutorial Guild' sign painted on the wall in dungeon script.

add.name: (Unread notification)
add.note: Earned for the first damage he dealt to a mob, the goblin at the guild door. Queued unread: his inventory is not yet active, so he cannot open the notification.

add.name: (Unread notification)
add.note: Earned for his first mob kill. Queued unread: his inventory is not yet active, so he cannot open the notification.

add.name: (Unread notification)
add.note: Earned for beating a club-wielding goblin unconscious with his fists, then smashing its head against the stones. Queued unread: his inventory is not yet active, so he cannot open the notification.

add.name: (Unread notification)
add.note: Earned for entering the Tutorial Guild hall. Queued unread: his inventory is not yet active, so he cannot open the notification.

add.name: Mordecai
add.note: Rat Hooligan, Level 50. A Non-Combatant NPC and former crawler (reached Floor 11). Runs this tutorial guildhall and, reluctantly, lets Carl in to escape the goblins.

update.note: Designated Crawler #4,119 'Princess Donut', Level 1, Race: Cat, Class: not yet assigned. Auto-grouped with Carl into a party of two on entering the dungeon; she can see the game HUD too.
